The most serious crime he can be convicted of is **Involuntary manslaughter**. Transferred intent carries his intent to commit a non-deadly battery over to the killing, but intending only a slight wound does not supply the malice aforethought that murder requires. The killing still resulted from an unlawful act (shooting a gun at another person), which supports unlawful-act involuntary manslaughter.

CONFIDENCE: 65
